intro.title: Cross the Sea with Jesus
intro.body: Evening falls as Jesus and His disciples cross the Sea of Galilee. Prepare the boat, respond when the storm rises, and remember what Scripture says happened on the water.

questions.title: The crossing begins
questions.body: Jesus and His disciples leave the crowd and set out in the boat.

choices.label: As evening draws on
choices.response: The crossing begins as evening draws on.

choices.label: At sunrise
choices.response: Mark places the beginning of the crossing in the evening.

questions.title: Waves fill the boat
questions.body: A violent squall rises and waves break over the boat while the disciples struggle against the water.
questions.prompt: Where is Jesus during the storm?

choices.label: At the bow watching the waves
choices.response: Jesus is in the stern, asleep on a cushion.

choices.label: In the stern, asleep on a cushion
choices.response: Jesus is asleep on a cushion in the stern.

questions.title: Jesus rises
questions.body: The disciples wake Jesus. He rebukes the wind and addresses the sea.
questions.prompt: What happens after Jesus rebukes the storm?

choices.label: The wind ceases and there is great calm
choices.response: The wind ceases and the sea becomes calm. The disciples are filled with awe.

choices.label: The boat immediately reaches shore
choices.response: The wind ceases and there is great calm; the passage does not say the boat instantly reaches shore.

reflection.title: From fear to awe
reflection.body: The storm reveals both the disciples' fear and Jesus' authority over wind and sea. Faith does not pretend the danger is unreal; it remembers who is present in the boat.
